## Active

### D-019 — blong-party demonstrates the profile feature too

> _2026-08-21 · realm/blong-party · active_

The blong-party app gained the blong-access browser child, the `profile` config and the
`integration` testHook block, plus a `partyTestProfileMerge` dbTest seed that links testAdmin to a
`party.person` row through `hasProfile`. Verified explicitly while doing it: the access browser
child, the profile config and the testHook on their own do NOT break google or self-registration —
only nesting `login`/`google` inside the inner `portal` did.
